about: We are Cia. VENDAVAL. We make music and circus in the street. We are from Barcelona and Terrassa.
We are a band. We play saxophones, trumpet, sousaphone and drums. The musicians come from Europe and from America.

There are circus artists with the band. One artist walks on stilts. Stilts are long poles on the legs. Another artist rides a unicycle. A unicycle is a bike with 1 wheel. They juggle and play games with the audience.
We lead the band with hand signs. The audience learns the signs and leads the band too.
We have performed in Catalonia, Andorra and Germany.
shows: We make shows for the street. Some shows have 1 artist. Some shows have 8 artists.
workshops: We give circus and music workshops. The workshops are for young people and adults.
We give the workshops on the same day as one of our shows. We come from Barcelona.

brass: VENDAVAL Brass is a band that walks through the street.
There are 6 musicians and 2 circus artists. One artist is on stilts. The other artist rides a unicycle. They juggle.
The band plays music for dancing: cumbia, funk, Balkan music and swing.
The audience plays with nets and life rings. The audience learns hand signs and leads the band.
Each show lasts 30 minutes. We can do several shows in one day.
Before the show, blind people can touch the costumes and the instruments.
friend: Imaginary Friend is a giant soft toy.
The soft toy walks on 4-legged stilts. It walks through the audience and looks for friends to play with.
There are 3 ways to do the show: with an acrobat, with a musician, or the soft toy alone.
freakfrac: Freak Frac is a parade. A parade is a show that walks through the street.
There are very tall characters on stilts. They walk behind a band.
They juggle and skip with a rope.
Freak Frac belongs to Cia. Filigranes. We do it together.
joc: El Joc Etern is a new show. We are still making it.
3 sea creatures look for a magic game. They invite the audience to look for the game.
They travel with Windy. Windy is an electric scooter that pulls a boat. The boat is also a musical instrument.
There are 5 artists. They do stilts, unicycle, juggling, music and games.
In 2027 we will invent games for all people. You can touch the games, feel them as vibrations and play them in sign language.
